story.lede: I used to pick a side. Now I take a feature the whole way — from the database table to the screen people click.
paragraphs: I'm a web developer in Batam, Indonesia. I studied Informatics Engineering at Batam State Polytechnic (Politeknik Negeri Batam).
What I like most is taking work that still runs on paper and turning it into a system people use every day. The two stories below are the clearest examples.
